signals.text: 2 open PM roles across 1 US office

bullets: Own and lead product initiatives across Clerkie’s platform, from discovery through release
Collaborate deeply with engineering and design to shape scalable product solutions
Translate complex partner and ecosystem needs into clear product requirements
Drive cross-functional alignment across technical and non-technical stakeholders
Work directly with enterprise partners to understand workflows and product opportunities
Partner with PMs, designers, and engineers to explore problems and shape solutions
Work directly on high-priority initiatives across our SaaS products
Support discovery, documentation, and delivery for key product work streams
Join (and contribute to!) team rituals like sprint planning, retros, and roadmap reviews
Help scope and ship features from research through release
